items.name: Red Dagger Ring
items.lore: A plain ring with a single red stone. Every Red Dagger wears one. Sigrid doesn't, now.

items.name: Trapper's Snow-Cloak
items.lore: White fur, thick enough to sleep in.

items.name: Bounty-Notice Charm
items.lore: Sigrid's own bounty notice, folded small. She laughs every time she sees it.

items.name: Bloodnail's Belt
items.lore: Hung with the sheaths of a dozen knives. Empty, now.

items.name: Grani's Mane-Braid
items.lore: Eight braids of grey mane, one for each leg. The gods' own horse-blood.

items.name: Fenrir Blood-Bowl Torc
items.lore: Beaten from the fenrir's blood-bowl. Scrubbed. Scrubbed again.

items.name: Breeder's Saddle-Belt
items.lore: Hroald's own, from forty years of riding.

items.name: Eight-Hoof Ring
items.lore: A ring of eight tiny silver hooves.

items.name: Jarl's Rein-Bracer
items.lore: The bracer of a jarl's horse-master.
